title: guid
summary: GuidInfo implements the current 1.12 GUID layout including family tags, ordinary 24-bit entries, MO_TRANSPORT's low-32 entry, explicit pet exclusion from Entry(), and HIGHGUID_PET's 24-bit pet-number extraction consumed by pet-name queries.

openItems.text: pet_number() extraction and its consumer CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY are absent - the one guid decode Benilla ships for pet naming has no MSUI counterpart, so pet guids can never be resolved to names
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: GuidInfo.PetNumber returns bits 24..47 only for HIGHGUID_PET, and the name ingress uses it for exact CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY requests.
